1. A structure, comprising:
a front body frame configured to surround a front surface of an airframe;
a crash unit disposed at a front end of the front body frame; and
a dash reinforcement assembly fastened to the front body frame and disposed on a rear surface of the crash unit.
2. The structure of claim 1, wherein the crash unit comprises:
a crash box formed in a longitudinal direction of the crash unit;
an upper frame disposed between a front end of the crash box and the dash reinforcement assembly; and
a lower frame fastened to the upper frame and disposed at a lower front end of the crash box.
3. The structure of claim 2, wherein the crash box further comprises one or more curved portions, protruding upwards, formed in the longitudinal direction of the crash unit.
4. The structure of claim 2, wherein the lower frame is configured to surround at
least a portion of an outer side of the dash reinforcement assembly.
5. The structure of claim 2, wherein an end of the crash box facing the dash reinforcement assembly further comprises a supporting surface coupled, in surface contact,
with the dash reinforcement assembly.
6. The structure of claim 2, wherein the crash box comprises:
a first inclined portion configured to have a first setting angle with respect to a longitudinal direction of the airframe; and
a second inclined portion configured to have a second setting angle larger than the first setting angle with respect to the first inclined portion.
7. The structure of claim 1, wherein the dash reinforcement assembly comprises:
an outer reinforcement formed at a position facing the crash unit;
an inner reinforcement disposed adjacent to an interior configured to position a passenger; and
a shock absorber disposed between the outer reinforcement and the inner reinforcement.
8. The structure of claim 1, further comprising a floor assembly fastened to the dash reinforcement assembly and configured to receive impact that is applied to the crash unit.
9. The structure of claim 8, wherein the floor assembly further comprises a skid
unit overlapping and contacting the front body frame and the crash unit.
10. A structure, comprising:
a front body frame configured to surround a front surface of an airframe;
a crash unit disposed at a front end of the front body frame and configured such
that a lower end is inclined in a longitudinal direction of the airframe; anda dash reinforcement assembly fastened to the front body frame and disposed on a rear surface of the crash unit.
11. The structure of claim 10, wherein the crash unit comprises:
a crash box fonned in a longitudinal direction of the crash unit;
an upper frame disposed between a front end of the crash box and the dash reinforcement assembly; and
a lower frame fastened to the upper frame and disposed at a lower end of the front
end of the crash box.
12. The structure of claim 11, wherein the crash box further comprises one or more curved portions formed in the longitudinal direction of the crash unit and disposed in a height direction.
13. The structure of claim 11, wherein the crash boxcomprises a U-shaped cross- section.
14. The structure of claim 11, wherein the upper frame comprises an L shaped side
cross-section.
15. The structure of claim 11, wherein the crash box comprises:
a first inclined portion configured to have a first setting angle with respect to the longitudinal direction of the airframe; and
a second inclined portion configured to have a second setting angle larger than the first setting angle with respect to the first inclined portion.
16. The structure of claim 10, wherein the dash reinforcement assembly comprises:
an outer reinforcement formed at a position facing the crash unit;
an inner reinforcement disposed adjacent to an interior configured to position a passenger; and
a shock absorber disposed between the outer reinforcement and the inner reinforcement.
17. The structure of claim 10, further comprising a floor assembly fastened to the dash reinforcement assembly and configured to receive impact that is applied to the crash unit.
18. The structure of claim 17, wherein the floor assembly further includes a skid unit overlapping the front body frame and the crash unit in a contact state. 5 10 15 20
